diversity: The six historical topics remain: rescheduling a neighbour visit, work delay, pharmacy help, a broken fridge, visiting the hairdresser and retrieving a wallet at a cafe. The fridge premise now motivates a size choice and the hairdresser visit becomes a sequence, both acceptable under the authorised format rewrite. Compare modern neighbour introduction, pharmacy-adjacent waiting-room description, online/shop choice and clothes-alteration sequence: communicative operations differ. This migration group is not a complete mock form; service settings predominate.
author_doubts_decisions: Fridge purchase preserves the broken-fridge practical topic while providing the required two-picture task.
Hairdresser visit and wallet search preserve the historical subjects while making all three panels useful.
Hairdresser sample sitting sentence removed: the broad second criterion allows describing sitting, so the original null was indefensible.
Retain Roos’s bun/scarf and trimming a loose strand; generation review must confirm the haircut is visually legible.
No organisation-name search is needed for unnamed shops and services.
media_notes: No media generated or reviewed. After the hash gate, generate six narrator instructions, two character cues and eleven illustrations. Verify pharmacy handover and box pickup, two refrigerator heights using the same adult scale, visible hair cutting with bun/scarf intact, coherent payment terminal, an empty search panel and a blue-wallet return. Existing legacy audio cannot represent the rewritten prompts.
